scope: Current-evidence refresh for Lightning of Absolution, Lovely Cyclone, Mach Dash, and Maiden Blast

records.name: Lightning of Absolution
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 111 — The Zero Mortal Plan
records.mechanics: Tracking, long-range, 2-hit lightning attack; current reference describes an initial halo lightning attack followed by two strikes from above.

records.name: Lovely Cyclone
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 135 — Ribrianne, Defender of Love and Justice
records.mechanics: Short-range two-stage move that twirls to draw in the opponent; a follow-up input tackles the opponent, while the completed sequence improves stamina depletion against guarding opponents.
limits: No Ultimate-Finish-only gate is inferred; repository's false flag is preserved.

records.name: Mach Dash
records.mechanics: High-speed evasive dash that creates distance and temporarily increases movement speed; current reference reports an approximately 11.5-second duration.
limits: Repository crosslink data also preserves PQ11 as a historical/legacy endpoint discrepancy; current skill-page evidence supports PQ18 for Xenoverse 2.

records.name: Maiden Blast
records.source_character: Pan; Videl Customize Partner; Kefla (Super Saiyan) Customize Partner
records.mechanics: Short-range explosive Ultimate: creates a surrounding Ki explosion, then concentrates it into a large ball that detonates; current reference reports 34 hits.
limits: No unsupported reward gate or probability inferred.
